description: Minimum attendance of 75% of classes held in a subject till MSE/ESE to appear in MSE/ESE
Dean Academics may allow relaxation in the minimum attendance up to 10% (documented authorised activity / medical reasons, submitted to HoD within 7 days)
Under exceptional circumstances a further relaxation up to 5% on committee recommendation
Attendance relaxation may be granted a maximum of 2 times during the programme
Not permitted to appear in MSE/ESE if attendance is below 60% after relaxation
